Instagram Mixcloud Website Matteo ran a record shop in Turin before he joined Radio Onda. Café Onda is the closest thing the station has to a breakfast show: soul, funk, a few new releases and the weather in Barcelona. On Thursdays he hosts Fuori Orario, the record shop side of him: Italo disco, library music and film scores. He answers every message that comes in during the show, usually on air. On air Every week with Matteo. All shows Café Onda Soul, funk and new releases to start the day, with Matteo on the phones.
